spec.description:
Foilboard Ultra Fasteners are extra-long, heavy-duty mechanical
fixings equipped with oversized load-spreading washer plates, engineered
specifically for installing thick Foilboard panels (40mm and 50mm) to timber
framing. The extended shank ensures sufficient timber embedment depth through
thick expanded polystyrene boards, while the enlarged washer prevents fastener
pull-through under high wind loads or ceiling gravity sag. They provide secure,
non-compressing mechanical attachment for high-R-value residential walls, raked
ceilings, and underfloor applications.
features:
Engineered specifically
for thick 40mm and 50mm Foilboard panels

Extended shank lengths (70mm
to 100mm) ensure deep structural embedment in timber

Extra-wide spreader
plate head eliminates foil tear-through and panel deformation

Heavy-duty
galvanized or coated steel construction provides long-term corrosion
resistance

Prevents heavy high-R-value boards from sagging in overhead
ceiling applications

Simple hammer-in or drive-in installation into timber
framing studs and joists

Maintains planar panel alignment across deep wall
framing and underfloors

technical.value:
Extended galvanized nail or screw with
oversized load-spreading washer plate

70 mm, 80 mm, 90 mm, 100 mm (tailored for 40mm and 50mm
boards)

spec.fire:
Non-combustible steel fastener with
low-hazard washer; compliant with NCC fire requirements
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 3999, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
100%
recyclable steel and polymer components; zero ODP
install:
Position 40mm
or 50mm Foilboard panel firmly against timber framing studs or ceiling joists
Place Ultra Fastener against the panel surface at specified fixing points

Drive fastener through the thick board into the timber until the broad washer
rests flat against the foil

Do not overdrive to avoid crushing the thick EPS
core

Fix at maximum 600mm centers along perimeter edges and down central
studs

In ceiling applications, support panels while driving fasteners to
ensure tight structural contact

Tape over all fastener heads with
Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape for airtightness
selection_checklist:
Confirm board thickness is 40mm or 50mm (for thinner boards use Standard
Fasteners)
Verify timber embedment depth is at least 25mm into framing
Calculate fastener quantity (approx. 6-8 fasteners per 2440x1200mm sheet)
limitations:
Designed for timber framing; for steel
framing use Ultra Tek Screws

Ensure fastener length is sufficient to
penetrate solid timber behind 50mm boards

Non-structural; does not replace
primary cladding fixings

problem_keywords:
standard
fasteners too short for 50mm board

use_cases:
Securing
thick 40mm and 50mm Foilboard Green panels to residential timber wall studs
Fastening high-R-value 50mm panels to raked timber cathedral ceilings
Installing thick rigid panels in high-performance subfloor timber joist bays
